what: The decko-ts standing verification net: every live file of the fold-verification net, reconciled into ONE checked-in list. Submit it as a single machine test queue job with the runner (see canonicalCommand).

provenance.howToRead: Each entry below records what a group of listed files covers and the date its coverage was verified. The `files` list is the net itself; the entries here say why a file is in it, so a file that goes stale is traceable to the coverage it was added for.

Delegated-render rescue scope (tests/card/render/date-delegated-core-rescue-scope-pins.test.ts), added 2026-10-02: every render! in Ruby is independently rescued (card/lib/card/format/render.rb:7-14, :96-100) and render_core from inside a view body is a NEW render! (format/method_delegation.rb:41-47), so a raising delegated core RETURNS the render-error span, the enclosing wrap still emits its card-slot div, and the error is labelled with the DELEGATED view (format/error.rb:80-86). The Date arm of the dispatch gate sat one level too high and skipped the view body, so a nested +Date lost its slot. Listed so the net guards the nested surface (wrapped, quiet, core-labelled) AND the focal surface (still re-raises) together.

Gherkin behavior layer (tests/card/gherkin/ — the three .feature.test.ts files: card-crud, names, views; 31 scenarios ported from the Ruby Gherkin features), added 2026-10-03: the layer sat outside every gate, so the enrichTemplateLinkSetJunctions render change (wave1, carried by fold-8) broke 2 structure.feature renders on lineages that carry it (CodenameNotFoundError: unknown codename: right) and only a manual lane run noticed. Fixed in the gherkin-gate lane by seeding the codename cards and installing the DB-backed name environment (gherkin-storage.ts). Listed so the net guards the layer in every standing-net run. Verified green at 5cd5646: 31/31.

Hops gate (tests/card/render/hops-per-render-one-page-law.test.ts), added 2026-10-03: the operator law 'one page, one database hit' as a mechanical gate — a fixture page's cold render must stay under the enumerated ceiling (1 page batch + the justified exception classes; see the file header and the db-roundtrip-elimination receipt's per-hop justifications) and the warm re-render must not re-ask beyond the late-seat type exception. Listed so any engine change that re-inflates hop counts fails the build.

Machine lane worktree disk hygiene gate (tests/hygiene/machine-lane-worktree-disk-hygiene.test.ts, with its checked-in permanent-keeps file tests/hygiene/keep-worktrees.json), added 2026-10-03: the operator law 'cleanup that doesn't manage itself is illegal — no durable system may rely on the lead agent's memory or discipline' as a mechanical gate. Enumerates lane worktrees on this machine (C:/localProjects/decko-ts-lane-* and brandonDojoTech-lane-* directories, plus registered-but-missing entries from git worktree list in both repos) and fails the build when (a) a lane worktree is neither actively tracked in IN-FLIGHT.json lanes[] nor in keep-worktrees.json — the failure names each with its exact 'git worktree remove' command, the failure message IS the remediation; (b) the disallowed worktrees' depth-2-capped size FLOOR (an honest lower bound of true size) exceeds 1 GB; or (c) more than 15 lane worktrees exist on disk regardless of allowlists; stale registrations are named with the repo-scoped 'git worktree prune' remediation. BORN RED BY DESIGN (proof committed beside the gate: 20 disallowed named, 2.60 GB disallowed floor vs 1 GB budget, 25 on disk vs cap 15, captured while the cleanup lane was actively pruning); it turns GREEN only when the cleanup finishes and IN-FLIGHT.json reflects reality — the budgets must never be weakened to force green, and raising any of them requires a receipt justification in the same commit. Machine-scoped on purpose: on a machine without C:/localProjects it fails loud instead of passing silent. Verified at 61d65e6: standalone run 1 test / 1 failed (the born-red failure IS the guard working), tsc 0, new files LF.

Listed so the net guards the override universe in every standing-net run.

Self::Mod object-address shape parity (tests/card/content/mod-object-address-shape-parity.test.ts), added 2026-10-04 (mod-address-normalization lane): card-1.110.0 mod/core/set/self/mod.rb:4-6 interpolates the mod OBJECT and Cardio::Mod defines no #to_s, so Ruby prints the object's heap address into the record view — the one graded entry no port could byte-match. The port renders Ruby's exact Object#to_s template with a genuine per-process opaque id, and the comparator canonicalizes the address on both sides (src/testing/diff.ts normalizeModObjectAddresses), so the entry passes as a normal test with a documented normalization instead of a standing exception. Listed so the net guards the shape contract, the anchored scope of the mask, and the mod ordering the bytes themselves cannot carry.

provenance.relnames-source: relnames bar-title shape gate (2026-10-04): the census-M1 view-lane bar-context seat writes the format working context list, which is what RenderFormat#standardTitle relativizes the bar title against, so a seat firing on a bar the corpus shows ctx-less renders a relative title where the fixture and the graded capture carry the absolute compound name (11 set-card-views surfaces, 2.6-2.8KB each). The gate scopes the seat to the pointer/list ITEM bar shape it was fitted to (Guns:open); the set card Rules bars are the excluded accordion chain (bar.rb:40 never runs add_name_context). relnames-set-card-accordion-bar-title-must-stay-absolute-pins.test.ts is the RED-first pin (absolute title and no name_context on the *input type+*right accordion bar, plus the blast-radius control that the pointer-list item bar still seats and still relativizes). relnames-lane-bar-title-slot-census-dump.test.ts is the env-gated (RELNAMES_DUMP=1) engine-vs-fixture first-diff probe measuring the same surfaces; it self-skips without its pin.

envGuard.what: Standing-net env pin (auditor F16). The queue runner is long-lived and spawns the net from ITS OWN environment, so oracle env exported in a submitting shell dies at the queue boundary; a no-env run silently becomes a skip-heavy invalid net that still exits 0. requiredEnv must be present in run-standing-net's own environment, or forwarded with --env (the queue's persisted env channel, which reaches the job and is counted in the dedupe key).
